implementation_summary: Added a browser integration test that runs runAuditCrawl against fixtures/audit-site (default limits) and an inline server (401 page, sign-in form, card-field page, provider-frame page, click-only button/div, GET form), asserting on server request logs, browser requests, fake-DNS lookups and connects that the crawl only reads: GET/HEAD only, no credentials/body/cookie, sign-in and payment pages skipped with the right reasons and nothing behind them requested, nothing to off-site hosts, click-only and form-action targets unrequested.

tests_executed.name: Audit crawl sends only reads
